subject: GEN3 PHASE 1 START: exact cover prewarm CAS authority
body: Primary has started Gen3 Phase 1 against main 45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e. Scope is P0.1 only: replace tokenless V3 PREWARM authority transfer with an explicit V4 compare-and-swap contract. New owner identity will carry serviceEpoch + closeCycleId + transitionGeneration; adoption of any non-IDLE lease requires the exact current shellSession/leaseId/leaseEpoch/owner identity. A delayed older prewarm must mutate nothing. Fresh-IDLE acquisition remains explicit. Same-owner retry must be idempotent. Coordinator will reconcile/retry when two tokenless first-acquisition requests cross before either response is accepted. V3 remains compatibility-only; Gen3 will use V4. No production GitHub write has been made.
